title: Generate partial JSON updates with structured paths
goal: Update a JSON root, nested property or array element while preserving siblings when migrating an update-generator extension.

selectionNotes: The pinned assembly calls the type StructuredJsonPath, not the conflicting source draft name. EF10 carries a string path; EF11 carries segments and separate array indices. The public UpdateSqlGenerator hook is exercised directly to generate a bounded SQL Server assignment; it is not a registered replacement for the SQL Server provider generator and does not implement batching, concurrency or arbitrary provider updates. StructuredJsonPath.ToString takes an optional wildcard character, not a quoting character. Render property segments explicitly: a dot in a property name must remain one quoted segment. Reject unspecified or negative indices. The fixture tests the dotted name odd.name, concrete index 1, nested properties and whole-document replacement; it does not promise every possible SQL JSON path escape or SQL native json behavior. All values use @value. Root replacement intentionally replaces the document; sibling preservation applies to partial changes.
